description: Synthetic, deterministic. The /team page shows three member photos; each member's name and 'View <first name>'s profile' link sit in a figcaption that the page's CSS hides (display: none) until the figure is hovered, and the page tells the user to hover over a photo. The test asserts toBeVisible on getByText("View Ana's profile") without hovering first, so the link exists (the locator resolves to it) but stays hidden. The app behaves as designed. A control that hovers over the 'Ana Lopez' photo first, then asserts and clicks, reaches /team/ana-lopez and passes against the same app. failureType incorrect_locator is the closest existing type: the locator is correct and resolves; the defect is the missing hover interaction before the conditionally visible link is used. The CSS rule is not inspectable through the investigator's tools; that hover reveals the link is an inference from the spec (no hover), the page's instruction text, and the hidden state of an element that exists. Neither get_trace_summary nor the screenshot is required.

rootCause.summary: The profile link exists (the locator resolves to it) but is hidden until the member's photo is hovered; the test asserts its visibility and would click it without hovering first.

criteria.description: Recognizes that the link is hidden, not visible
Recognizes that the link is present (the locator resolved to it), not missing
Identifies hovering over the photo as what reveals the link, which the test never does

forbiddenClaims.description: Claims the link is missing or not in the page
forbiddenClaims.pattern: (link|element|anchor)( is| was)? (missing|absent|removed)|(link|element|anchor) (does not|doesn't|did not|didn't) exist|no (such )?(profile )?link (exists|on the page)

forbiddenClaims.description: Claims the page, its CSS or the hover behavior is broken

forbiddenClaims.pattern: race condition|too slow|loads? slowly|needs? more time|did not (load|render|appear) in time

forbiddenClaims.description: Blames the locator's text or selector

requiredEvidence.why: Confirmed (Playwright 1.64.1): the error is toBeVisible on getByText("View Ana's profile") with Expected: visible, Received: hidden, and the call log says the locator resolved to <a href="/team/ana-lopez">, so the link exists but is hidden
The spec asserts and clicks the link with no hover before it
Confirmed (Playwright 1.64.1): the page snapshot shows the instruction to hover over a member's photo and the three member images, and no link node (hidden elements are left out)

acceptable.description: Hover over the member's photo (or figure) before asserting on and clicking the link

forbidden.description: Dispatches a synthetic click on the hidden link
Skips the link and navigates to the profile URL directly
Changes the app or injects styles so the link is always visible
